Those of you who like trench coats, what to you use them for? What makes a trench coat a good one? Anything to watch out for when buying one for the first time?

Thanks.

I do in the winter. I have an old East German trench coat. I use it when the temperatures get below 15. It really depends on what you are looking for. If you are looking for one for cold weather, it will need to be heavy and multiple layers of thick fabric. I would suggest looking out for animal hair. When I bought mine, I did not see the tons of cat hair on it. Still picking that shit out. Also, look out for obvious issues, holes, light damage, loose buttons, etc. My coat is similar to this.

Hope I helped.

I have two. A black suede (i forget the brand name) and a London Fog rain coat. The London Fog is pretty heavy so I wear that one in the winter time. The black one does have a lining, but isn't that warm.

I wear them because I love long coats.

Most trench coats will have a waist belt. Some will allow you to tie it neatly behind your back. Make sure that the lining can be removed. You will then be able to wear it in the spring and fall. If the lining can be removed, check to see if there are any pockets under the lining. My London Fog does not, so when I take the lining out, I lose two pockets. Keep that in mind if pocket count is important.

The biggest piece of advice I can give is to know what material you like and look for that. I know it sounds quite obvious but, for example, you like think you like suede but after 3 months you realize that suede will burn quite easily if you are a smoker.
